s2.ptxt: Install the wiper rubber LH to the wiper rubber backing plate.

item.ptxt: Align the recess of the wiper rubber backing plate with the protrusion of the wiper rubber LH.
Make sure the curvature of the wiper rubber backing plate faces the same direction as the curvature of the windshield glass.

s2.ptxt: Install the wiper rubber LH to the front wiper blade LH so that the head (the bulged end) of the wiper rubber LH faces the arm shaft side.

atten3.ptxt: Push in firmly so that the engagement portion of the front wiper blade LH is fully engaged with the recess at the end of the wiper rubber LH.

s2.ptxt: Install the front wiper blade LH to the front wiper arm LH.
Install the holder of the front wiper blade LH as shown in the illustration.
